items.title: Login / OTP wall before cart: Allow guest cart and defer login to checkout, or offer guest checkout.
items.body: Allow guest cart and defer login to checkout, or offer guest checkout.
items.why_it_helps: Add to cart requires an OTP login that is sent by SMS and cannot be read by an agent.
items.how_to_verify: Add-to-cart 401 count falls; PDP to cart step conversion for agents rises.
items.verify_metric: Agent sessions ending with B06 per day
items.llm_explanation: 22% of failed agent sessions (417) ended on login / otp wall before cart. Typical failing call: POST /api/cart -> 401 AUTH_REQUIRED. Fixing it could recover about ₹170,734 a month.

items.title: Size guide is image-only: Provide an HTML table size guide.
items.body: Provide an HTML table size guide.
items.why_it_helps: The size guide is served only as an image, so text-based agents cannot read sizes.
items.how_to_verify: Site check "size guide has HTML table" passes; size-guide sessions continue to cart.
items.verify_metric: Agent sessions ending with B09 per day
items.llm_explanation: 22% of failed agent sessions (419) ended on size guide is image-only. Typical failing call: GET /size-guide/mens-sneakers -> 200. Fixing it could recover about ₹73,606 a month.

items.title: Pincode / serviceability wall: Make pincode optional before cart, accept it by URL or API, and show the delivery promise without a modal.
items.body: Make pincode optional before cart, accept it by URL or API, and show the delivery promise without a modal.
items.why_it_helps: Add to cart is rejected until a pincode is entered through a modal that agents cannot use.
items.how_to_verify: Add-to-cart 409 PINCODE_REQUIRED count falls to near zero; PDP to cart step conversion for agents rises.
items.verify_metric: Agent sessions ending with B05 per day
items.llm_explanation: 5% of failed agent sessions (89) ended on pincode / serviceability wall. Typical failing call: POST /api/cart -> 409 PINCODE_REQUIRED. Fixing it could recover about ₹36,440 a month.

items.title: JS-only product content: Server-render price and stock and include them in JSON-LD.
items.body: Server-render price and stock and include them in JSON-LD.
items.why_it_helps: Price and stock are rendered only by client-side JavaScript, so non-JS fetchers see no price.
items.how_to_verify: Site check "PDP price in server HTML" passes; fetcher sessions go past the PDP.
items.verify_metric: Agent sessions ending with B03 per day
items.llm_explanation: 27% of failed agent sessions (498) ended on js-only product content. Typical failing call: GET /p/navy-daily-walk-sneaker -> 200. Fixing it could recover about ₹43,798 a month.

items.title: Out-of-stock dead end: Suggest in-stock alternatives and expose availability per variant in HTML and JSON-LD.
items.body: Suggest in-stock alternatives and expose availability per variant in HTML and JSON-LD.
items.why_it_helps: Choosing an out-of-stock variant returns an error with no alternatives suggested.
items.how_to_verify: Sessions ending on variant 409 OUT_OF_STOCK fall; variant to cart conversion rises.
items.verify_metric: Agent sessions ending with B08 per day
items.llm_explanation: 2% of failed agent sessions (32) ended on out-of-stock dead end. Typical failing call: POST /api/cart -> 409 OUT_OF_STOCK. Fixing it could recover about ₹5,621 a month.

items.title: Interstitial / popup overlay: Delay or remove overlays, never block content, and provide an accessible close button.
items.body: Delay or remove overlays, never block content, and provide an accessible close button.
items.why_it_helps: A full-screen app-download or email-capture overlay covers the page and stalls browsing agents.
items.how_to_verify: Browsing-agent sessions continue past the landing or PDP view; replay shows no overlay.
items.verify_metric: Agent sessions ending with B07 per day
items.llm_explanation: 8% of failed agent sessions (144) ended on interstitial / popup overlay. Typical failing call: GET /p/bandhani-flared-kurta-in-sky-blue -> 200. Fixing it could recover about ₹12,664 a month.
